name: identical text has no word change
rulesText: Thanks for the update. I will review it tonight.
output: Thanks for the update. I will review it tonight.

name: surrounding whitespace is trimmed
rulesText: Thanks for the update um.
output: Thanks for the update.

name: case and punctuation changes alone are rejected
rulesText: so we should ship it on friday
output: So we should ship it on Friday.

name: case and punctuation changes with a removed word are accepted
rulesText: so um we should ship it on friday
output: So we should ship it on Friday.
text: So we should ship it on Friday.

name: oxford comma alone is rejected
rulesText: Buy milk, eggs and bread.
output: Buy milk, eggs, and bread.

name: empty output for text with words
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.

name: whitespace output for text with words
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.

name: output for empty input
output: Hello there

name: think tag
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.
output:
<think>

</think>

Send the report by Friday.

name: closing think tag only
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.
output: </think> Send the report by Friday.

name: length blow up
rulesText: Send the report.
output: Send the report. I have sent the report to everyone on the team and added a friendly note at the end of it.

name: short text length slack
rulesText: Hi.
output: Hi there.

name: dropped sentence
rulesText: The build failed on the staging server. The logs show a timeout in the database layer. We should restart it tomorrow.
output: The build failed on the staging server.

name: dropped single word in short text
rulesText: Ship the release candidate tonight.
output: Ship the release tonight.

name: one dropped word in a long text is allowed
rulesText: The report covers the third quarter revenue, the staffing plan, the new office lease and the hiring forecast for next year.
output: The report covers the third quarter revenue, the staffing plan, the new office lease and the hiring forecast.
text: The report covers the third quarter revenue, the staffing plan, the new office lease and the hiring forecast.

name: added word
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.
output: Send the final report by Friday.

name: added sentence
rulesText: Send the report by Friday.
output: Send the report by Friday. Let me know if you have questions.

name: replaced word
rulesText: Please review the pull request.
output: Please inspect the pull request.

name: gonna expansion is rejected
rulesText: I'm gonna send it tomorrow morning.
output: I'm going to send it tomorrow morning.

name: self correction drops the first value
rulesText: Let's ship it Thursday, no, Friday.
output: Let's ship it Friday.

name: self correction with wait
rulesText: Meet at Monday no wait Tuesday at the cafe.
output: Meet at Tuesday at the cafe.
text: Meet at Tuesday at the cafe.

name: self correction cue words may be dropped
rulesText: Send it to Bob, sorry, to Alice.
output: Send it to Alice.

name: i mean correction
rulesText: The meeting is at three, I mean four.
output: The meeting is at 4.

name: no without commas is not a cue
rulesText: There was no time to review the second proposal.
output: There was time to review the second proposal.

name: self correction cannot drop everything
rulesText: Let's ship it Thursday, no, Friday.
output: Okay.

name: spelled numbers become digits
rulesText: The invoice is two thousand five hundred dollars.
output: The invoice is $2,500.

name: digits become words are fine
rulesText: We have 3 open tickets.
output: We have three open tickets.

name: lost number
rulesText: We have three open tickets for the release.
output: We have open tickets for the release.

name: invented number
rulesText: We have open tickets for the release.
output: We have 12 open tickets for the release.

name: date formatting
rulesText: The launch is on march third twenty twenty six.
output: The launch is on March 3, 2026.

name: email address
rulesText: Send it to john at example dot com please.
output: Send it to john@example.com please.

name: email address dropped user
rulesText: Send it to john at example dot com please.
output: Send it to example.com please.

name: file path spoken
rulesText: Open src slash app dot ts and fix the parser.
output: Open src/app.ts and fix the parser.
text: Open src/app.ts and fix the parser.

name: contraction without apostrophe
rulesText: i dont think that is right
output: I don't think that is right.

name: bulleted list of the same words
rulesText: pack sunscreen and a first aid kit and chargers
output:
Pack:
- Sunscreen
- A first aid kit
- Chargers
text:
Pack:
- Sunscreen
- A first aid kit
- Chargers

name: email layout alone is rejected
rulesText: hey sarah just wanted to follow up thanks john
output:
Hey Sarah,

Just wanted to follow up.

Thanks,
John

name: filler words in the input may go
rulesText: so like you know I think we should go
output: So I think we should go.
text: So I think we should go.

name: repeated word collapsing
rulesText: We are going going going to ship it.
output: We are going to ship it.
text: We are going to ship it.

name: translation is rejected
rulesText: Please send the report tomorrow.
output: Bitte senden Sie den Bericht morgen.

name: answering a question is rejected
rulesText: What is the capital of France?
output: The capital of France is Paris.

name: code identifier kept
rulesText: Rename fooBar to bazQux in the config.
output: Rename fooBar to bazQux in the config.

name: code identifier changed
rulesText: Rename fooBar to bazQux in the config.
output: Rename foo bar to baz qux in the config.
